title: Cable World Plastic 3 in 1 Portable Pretend Food Party Role Cooking Kitchen Play Set Toy for Boys and Girls
bullets: PORTABLE 3-IN-1 KITCHEN SET: Easily transforms from a compact suitcase into an exciting pretend kitchen play station. The portable design makes it convenient to carry, store and set up for playtime.

COMPLETE PRETEND COOKING EXPERIENCE: Includes a variety of play kitchen accessories such as pots, pan, cups, cooking utensils and pretend food pieces to create an engaging cooking role-play experience.

FUN ROLE PLAY & IMAGINATIVE PLAY: Children can pretend to cook, serve food and run their own little kitchen. Encourages imaginative storytelling, role play and interactive play with family or friends.
SPACE-SAVING & EASY TO STORE: After playtime, the kitchen accessories can be packed into the suitcase-style case for convenient storage. Suitable for bedrooms, playrooms and travel.

ATTRACTIVE GIFT FOR KIDS: Colourful kitchen-themed playset designed for pretend cooking activities and everyday role play. Suitable as a birthday, festival or special-occasion gift for boys and girls.
